name: morphing-discovery-bar
title: Morphing Discovery Bar
description: A rounded row of category pills with a search button at one end. Clicking search widens it into a typing field while the category pills blur and slide off, and a close button brings them back.
use: A filter row should stay compact but still offer search without opening a separate overlay.
avoid: The search field is visual only: typing filters nothing and no search callback fires.
a11y: The search and close buttons are icon-only with no label or clear focus style, so their purpose is unclear to keyboard and screen-reader users. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded capsule bar holding a small circular search button and four icon-and-label pills; the active pill gets a pale tinted background and a coloured label, while the others stay neutral grey.
behaves: Tapping the search circle springs it open into a wide input while the category pills blur, shrink and slide away, and a round X appears beside it. Pressing X clears the text and morphs the pills back into place.
customise: Pass a categories array of id, label, icon and the two active colours; the spring timing and the morph sizes are constants inside the source.
weight: light: A handful of pills and one input running layout and blur springs.
